releaseNotes: v1.4: Fixed Mosque Mode auto-restore back to Normal ringer mode (synchronous state commits, anti-vibrate-poisoning protection, triple-redundant restore alarms + 15-min watchdog + resume recovery + exact-alarm permission prompt); separated Pre-Jama'at Wudu/preparation alerts (timed relative to Mosque Mode Jama'at time) from Waqt-start transition alerts; improved Google Sign-In App Check flow (non-blocking pre-flight, exact Firebase SDK payload/headers, 1-tap copyable Device Debug Token & Console shortcut).
